results.title: Healthcare entrepreneurship: An integrative framework for ...
results.content: # Healthcare entrepreneurship: An integrative framework for future research. Healthcare entrepreneurship is of growing interest, but the area of research is not well defined and is disparate across disciplines. Our proposed healthcare entrepreneurship framework not only reflects variations in key factors, such as actors, activities, processes and outcomes within the parent disciplines, but also suggests gaps, connections and future opportunities for research. We find that healthcare entrepreneurship is different from work in healthcare or entrepreneurship alone. For the clinician-turned-entrepreneur and the serial entrepreneur now in healthcare, we provide three actionable insights to address some of the practical challenges in healthcare entrepreneurship. We advise that venture teams include individuals from both entrepreneurship and healthcare backgrounds to shorten the learning curve, particularly as they develop the evidence base for the offering. Healthcare entrepreneurs may need to develop new business models and revenue streams. Non-profit organizations can serve as interdisciplinary conveners to raise awareness of healthcare entrepreneurship needs.
